verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Navan exposing its own MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) can query Navan's travel/expense data — this is Navan acting as the MCP server/provider, not as a client consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence Navan (or its Ava assistant) can plug in and use tools from third-party MCP servers. Missing for 10: any documentation of Navan's AI features connecting to external MCP servers, any tool/plugin ecosystem for consuming outside MCP tools, and any hands-on confirmation of such client-side behavior.
